title: Orphan Games: Game Boy in the FPGA
summary: The original Game Boy rebuilt in the FPGA (VerilogBoy by Wenting Zhang, OHDL 1.0): its CPU, picture chip and sound in hardware, with Orphan's own boot ROM. Play free homebrew Game Boy games from the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Real NES controllers plug into the hashboard connectors (J1 and J2, or any J with ORPHAN_NES_PADS) through the same small 3.3 V adapter as the NES, either pad plays (not tested with a NES controller, yet). Disconnect every hashboard first. Carts up to 128 KB, no mapper / MBC1 / MBC3 / MBC5. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: Game Boy (cart, frame buffer, sound, pads, real NES pads on J1..J9)
